answer: An identity earns its seat through Chartered game designer balance sheet with game designers certification, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. A farm running 679 aliases would need 679 separate proofs, each costing about 101 POA or 15 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Hold the marble up to the light, weigh the zephyr of the attack, and keep the crystal of the verdict where everyone can audit it. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
